role: Director, Department of Planning & Development, Cook County
stance_basis: letter explicitly states no comments on the project
summary: Daniel J. Ferrone, Director of the Cook County Department of Planning & Development, submitted a letter indicating that his department had no comments on NIPC project 74-228 (Lincoln Highway widening) after appropriate consultation under OMB Circular A-95. His letter covered multiple projects and expressed neither support nor opposition to any of them. He is also listed as a copy recipient on a subsequent letter from the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission regarding the project's Interstate Planning Committee review.
complaint_summary: Ferrone's department stated it has no comments on NIPC 74-228 (among other listed projects) after appropriate consultation under OMB Circular A-95.
